card.name: Degrees of freedom in F statistics
card.fires_on: The numbers and comma inside the degrees-of-freedom brackets of an F statistic, such as F (3,48), in results text about Spanish or English reading tests.

modes.label: Inside F brackets
modes.description: The opening bracket, the digits, or the comma in F (3,48) or F (3,39) before the F value.

modes.label: Stray number spots
modes.description: Occasional odd spots in tables or short abbreviations, such as a space inside a number or the word of inside a code.
